pending.title: Understanding how people (actually) make decisions
pending.summary: A free, beginner-friendly online introduction to behavioural science for people whose work depends on getting others to act: campaigners, corporate relations specialists and communications staff. Covers how people make decisions, the two systems of thinking, a practical framework for building stronger messages, and a small set of decision-making biases you can apply straight away. Examples include getting a meeting, winning support for a cage-free policy, or getting someone to sign a petition.
